name: accuracy_check
description: Checks factual accuracy of the response
grading_rubric: Score 1 if the response is completely accurate with no factual errors when compared to the ground truth. Score 0 if there are any inaccuracies, false information, or missing critical facts.

name: helpfulness_rating
description: Rates how helpful and actionable the response is
grading_rubric: Rate the helpfulness from 1 to 5 based on how well it answers the user's question. 1 = Not helpful at all, completely unhelpful or off-topic. 2 = Slightly helpful, answers partially but missing key information. 3 = Moderately helpful, provides adequate answer but could be more complete. 4 = Very helpful, provides clear and complete answer with good detail. 5 = Extremely helpful, comprehensive answer with actionable advice and examples.

name: completeness_percentage
description: Measures what percentage of required information is included
grading_rubric: Evaluate how complete the response is as a percentage from 0 to 100. Compare against the ground truth to identify what information is present versus missing. 0-20 = Very incomplete, missing most critical information. 21-40 = Incomplete, has some basics but missing many important points. 41-60 = Partially complete, covers main points but lacks depth or details. 61-80 = Mostly complete, includes most important information with minor gaps. 81-100 = Complete or nearly complete, includes all or almost all required information.

name: tone_professionalism
description: Checks if response maintains professional and appropriate tone
grading_rubric: Score 1 if the response maintains a professional, respectful, and appropriate tone throughout. Score 0 if the tone is casual, dismissive, condescending, rude, or otherwise unprofessional.

name: clarity_score
description: Evaluates how clear and easy to understand the response is
grading_rubric: Rate clarity from 1 to 5 based on how well-written and understandable the response is for the target audience. 1 = Very unclear, confusing, or poorly written. 2 = Somewhat unclear, hard to follow or understand. 3 = Average clarity, understandable but could be clearer. 4 = Clear and well-written, easy to follow and understand. 5 = Exceptionally clear, perfectly articulated and easy for anyone to understand.
